item.title: Version 1.5.86
item.description:
✨ v1.5.86 Update

  • New way to buy Pro — OnText Pro is now sold through Paddle. New license keys are checked on your Mac, so Pro keeps working offline.
  • Gumroad purchases — If you bought Pro on Gumroad, updating swaps your key for a new OnText license automatically. There is nothing to do.
  • Action files — Import and export .otaction files from Settings → Actions → Action Files, or drop a file onto the Settings window.
  • Action Marketplace — Get actions from ontext.dev/marketplace and import them into OnText in one step.
  • Clearer failure notices — When an action fails, a short notice appears next to the cursor instead of an error window. Click Details to see the cause and use Fix It.
